_note: Posts and comments (City feed, profiles): how long they can be, how many a player can write, and what is refused. Links and phone numbers are refused (the usual way scams start), and so is anything containing a blocked word (matched as a whole word, any case). Admins extend 'blocked' here and in social_rules() (*_social_posts.sql), kept identical by scripts/check-life-config.mjs. Photos are snaps taken in the game only (no uploads from the phone).
